ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback. We are very sorry to hear you are having trouble with searing. We are here to help. 

It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator. This safety device is a component of all LP gas regulators and is designed to reduce the flow of gas in the event of a leak.

You can inadvertently activate the safety device without having a gas leak. Typically, this occurs if you do not wait a sufficient time between opening the tank valve and the burner control knobs or if one or more of the burner control knobs is in an open position when opening the LP tank valve. When the safety device has been activated the grill is referred to as being in “bypass”.

Keep in mind that the safety device reacts to gas leaks. If a grill is in bypass, the gas connections and hose should be tested for leaks with a soap and water solution.

If you do activate the gas regulator safety device, the grill may struggle to reach high temperatures or may not light at all, even with all burners on the START/HIGH setting.

To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:

-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.

- Visually confirm all burners are extinguished (no flame present) 

-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.

-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.

-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.

-Close the grill lid.

-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.

When you are done grilling:

-Turn all burner control knobs to the OFF position

-Turn off the LP tank valve last.

Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
My first positive impressions regarding the Weber Spirit E-310 Grill were the packaging and assembly process.  The packaging was so well done, with everything being carefully protected and labeled.  I watched a couple of YouTube videos on tips about putting it together and I thoroughly enjoyed the process.  It was fairly easy to assemble because the instructions were excellent.  You really can't make a mistake.
It has taken me a few tries to get used to cooking with this grill as the heat is a bit further from what you are cooking than what I am used to.  Actually, that's a positive thing because the meat doesn't get charred as easily as my other grill (although my husband likes it that way).  It is important also to let the grill get hot before you sear your meat, just as the instructions say.  The grill marks are nice and even.  
I like that you can easily remove the tray under the burners to clean it.
I absolutely LOVE that there is an indicator for propane level in your tank!  No more surprises when you go to grill and you're out of propane.  
This purchase is one that I am very pleased with and appreciate Weber making it available with the different features.
Results.Title: Contented Customer

The propane tank rests on the ground through a hole in the bottom of the cart. The grill cannot be moved without lifting the tank which can be stored inside the cart. Results.Title: Quality product but Moving this grill is not easy

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill in June and had some initial issue with it. Despite the issue, the grill works like a champ, as expected from a Weber. With the new grills Weber had changed the orientation of the flame tubes from front to back, so if you want to cook with a cooler zone and a hotter one, this grill accommodates. The issue was that the grill without the propane tank installed is top heavy and blew over in a strong wind when the grill was less than a week old. So I caution anyone to not set up the grill without installing the propane tank. The control panel was broken as a result of the fall and Weber grave me a credit after I replaced the control panel, which is above and beyond what was covered in the warranty. So I would recommend this grill to anyone looking for a superior grilling experience.
Results.Title: This grill works better than my previous grill

Results.ReviewText: I started with the Weber kettle in my teens from my father in the 80's. It's a brand I have never denied my entire life, donating mine to my daughters from time to time. We keep them covered and use regular maintenance, so even when donated they are in great condition. They are very well built and with a little care will last years, until you just can't stand it and have to buy a new model! For me it's either a Weber or nothing. I upgraded to the 3-burner here after having many 3 Spirit 2's. I apprciate the extra short heating up time and more even heat with the thrid burner. It's worth the extra $100 or so. Weber customer service when needed is always excellent as expected with any replacement parts and the warrenty with Webers is outstanding. Buy it, you will love it!!
Results.Title: It's a Weber...What else did your expect?

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback and congratulations on your new grill! We are sorry to learn that you are having difficulty controlling the heat with your new grill. We can help with some pointers!
 
New grills tend to run hotter than older grills because they are more reflective inside. We recommend setting the burners to the lowest setting for high heat until it has been used more, and only using 1 or 2 burners to reach lower heat settings. With 2 burners on low, you should be closer to 350-400F.

Our Care team is here to help. Please look for our follow-up email soon. Thank you!

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
